scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic finite-dimensional proof; classical icosahedral ETF and Takagi factorization acknowledged. No independent audit or exhaustive publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed degree two, complex dimension three and probability-normalized sphere measure.
No classification of every optimal basis or extension to higher degrees.
Older equivalent phase-reflection matrix constructions may exist under different terminology.
title: An icosahedral sharp sup-norm orthonormal basis of holomorphic quadratics on the complex three-variable unit sphere
